sources.label: Ildefonso P. Santos Jr. was the Philippines' pioneering landscape architect
He held the title of National Artist for Architecture in 2006, recognizing his foundational work in establishing landscape architecture as a professional discipline in the Philippines
Santos Jr. is the primary reference for Philippine landscape design history; detailed biography and major works are owned by ALE-PLAN-007-06 (Notable Filipino Planners). When landscape design
sources.description: articles reference major international figures like Frederick Law Olmsted (Central Park designer) or Thomas Wolff (contemporary ecological landscape design), those references do not extend beyond the scope of landscape design principles; they are not full professional biographies
